# Razia Driving Center

## About
Razia Driving Center is a driving school in Gulberg 2, Lahore offering one-to-one driving lessons with an experienced female instructor, Madam Razia. The AI assistant on the website is named Mani. Established in December 2016. Rated 5.0 from 133 Google reviews. 5,218+ students trained.

## Contact
- Address: 28/A, S Block, Gulberg 2, Lahore, 54660, Pakistan
- Phone: +92 309 4461407
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/923094461407
- Website: https://raziadrivingcenter.com

## Courses
- Basic Plan — Rs. 9,999 (7 days)
- PLUS Plan — Rs. 14,500 (10 days)
- PRO+ Plan — Rs. 21,750 (15 days)

## Pricing Rule
- Distance charge: km × 50 × course days × 2
- First 2 km free ONLY on the PLUS Plan
- Maximum distance: 30 km
- Training is NOT at the center. The instructor picks the student from home, trains in the student's own area, then drops them home.

## Services
- One-to-one private driving lessons
- Female driving instructor (Madam Razia)
- Real Lahore traffic training
- Parking and reversing skills
- Pick & drop from home
- Manual car with dual controls

## Areas Served
- Gulberg 2, Lahore
- Gulberg III, Lahore
- Lahore Cantt, Lahore
- Surrounding areas across Lahore

## Hours
- Driving Training: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM (Monday – Sunday)
- Consultation & Support: 7:00 AM – 12:00 AM (Monday – Sunday)
